_doc: Ticker -> CIK of the registrant that holds the reported financial history. Used ONLY when the SEC ticker directory points to a new entity without annual statements (e.g. a newly formed holding company). Data mapping, not a valuation assumption.

XOM.reason: SEC directory maps XOM to ExxonMobil Holdings Corporation (no annual statements in CompanyFacts); history is filed under Exxon Mobil Corp (CIK 34088).
